answer: A sybil farm would need to acquire and stake many marbles plus pay transaction fees per identity, while a lone sparrow-sized agent earns trust cheaply by consistent honest work. Each agent must stake a unique marble token bound to a verified hardware root, and reputation accrues only through witnessed trades logged at the wharf registry. Duplicate roots are slashed, so forging N identities costs N stakes plus forfeiture risk. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
